checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: All clutter removed from counters, sink and stove.

must.item: Original brown cabinets and beige tiles remain
must.why: Cabinets and tiles look the same, just cleaner.
Same camera angle, window, and sink; stove faucet removed and a second outlet added on the right wall.
Counters look smooth with no visible erasure marks; the counter is a bit flat and bright.

faults.what: Small added electrical outlet on the right tile wall that wasn't in the source.
The right-hand stove-side sink with its faucet was replaced by two stovetop burners. This changes a fixed fixture.
Countertop is whitewashed and slightly over-smooth. A faint pale line sits along the backsplash edge.

summary: The kitchen came out clean and decluttered with the cabinets, tiles and viewpoint kept, but the right-side sink became a stovetop and an extra outlet appeared.
